paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
heading: Puanin Siangthou Latna / (Eks 35.4-9)
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Thillat ahon tawitheihna ding un, Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in. Michih lungtang a uttak a pete a pan thilpiak na la ding hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

paite: Amau a pan thilpiak na lak ding hiai bang ahi. Dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal.
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

paite: Puanmalngat dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au leh khau hoih leh kel mul.
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

paite: Belampa vun sansaksa leh ngalvang vun leh singgi sing.
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

paite: Vak ding in sathau, thaunuh ding gimlim, gimnamtui a ding toh.
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

paite: Onik suangte, siampu puan leh awmtuamna a siat ding suangte.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

paite: Alak ua ka tentheihna ding in mun siangthou hon bawlsak uhen.
english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

paite: Nang ka hon etsak bangbang in, biakbuk lim bang in leh avanzat tengteng lim bang in na bawl ding ahi.
english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

paite: "Singgi sing in thukhun bawm na bawl ding ahi. Adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi dia, availam tong khat-le-akim ahi dia, asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm / (Eks 37.1-9)
english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

paite: Dangka-engtak in na luan dia, asunglam leh apolam na luan dia, akimvel ah dangka-eng lallukhu bawl in atung ah na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

paite: Dangka-eng in asikkual li na sung dia, aning lite ah na bulh ding hi. Sikkual nih apang khat ah a-om ding ua, sikkual dang nihte apang khat ah a-om ding uh.
english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

paite: Singgi sing chiang na bawl dia, dangka-eng in na luan ding ahi.
english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

paite: Thukhun bawm sik a sikkualte sung ah chiangte na thunlut dia, huaite thukhun bawm zawn ahihtheihna ding in.
english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

paite: Chiangte thukhun bawm sikkual sung ah a-om ding uhi.
english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

paite: Thukhun bawm sung ah ka hon piak theihsakna dudes na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

paite: "Dangka-engtak in zahngaihna tutphah na bawl dia; adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi dia, availam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

paite: Zahngaihna tutphah mong nihte ah, dangka-eng in cherubte na bawl dia, huaite sekthoh e in na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

paite: Among khat ah cherub khat na bawl dia, among langkhat ah cherub dang. Among nihte ah zahngaihna tutphah ah cherubte na bawl ding ahi.
english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

paite: Cherubte'n tungsang lam ah akhate uh azakkhe ding ua, akhate ua zahngaihna tutphah tuam in, amai un aki-entuah ding ua; zahngaihna tutphah lam ah cherubte mai a-om ding ahi.
english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

paite: Thukhun bawm tung ah zahngaihna tutphah na koih dia; thukhun bawm sung ah ka hon piak ding theihsakna na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

paite: Huai ah ka hon kimuhpih dia, zahngaihna tutphah tung a pan, theihsakna thukhun bawm tung a om cherub nihte kikal a pan Israel suante kiang a thupiak ka hon piak ding thil tengteng thu ah ka hon houpih ding hi.
english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

paite: "Singgi in dohkan na bawl dia; adunglam tong nih ahi dia; availam tong khat, asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
heading: Pathian Kiang A Tanghou Latna Dohkan / (Eks 37.10-16)
english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

paite: Dangka-engtak in na luan dia, akımvel in dangka-eng lallukhu na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

paite: Akimvel in khut chia in agei na bawl dia; akimvel in agei ah dangka-eng lallukhu na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

paite: Asikkual ding in dangka-eng in li na bawl dia; sikkualte aning lite akhe li tung a omte ah na koih ding.
english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

paite: Dohkan puakna ding chiangte a-omna ding in ageichin ah sikkualte a-om ding uh ahi.
english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

paite: Singgi in chiangte na bawl dia, dangka-eng in na luan dia, huaite dohkan akipuaktheihna ding ahi.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

paite: Akuangte, akeute, asinte, anoute, asitna ding in na bawl ding hi. Huaite dangka-engtak in na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

paite: Ka ma a dohkan tung ah tanghou sawm-le-nih na koih gige ding ahi.
english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

paite: "Dangka-engtak in khawnvak koihna na bawl ding ahi. Khawnvak koihna sekthoh in na bawl ding ahi. Akungpi leh ahiangte, apakmum leh apakte, kibang mah in na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Khawnvak Koihna / (Eks 37.17-24)
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

paite: Apangte a pan hiang guk akakhe dia; khawnvak koihna pang khat a pan hiang thum, khawnvak koihna pang dang a pan hiang thum.
english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

paite: Belkuang thumte makha bang a bawlte, hiang khat a pakmum leh pak; hiang dang a belkuang thumte makha bang a bawlte, pakmum leh pak; huchibang in khawnvak koihna a pan a hong suak hiang gukte.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

paite: Khawnvak koihna ah belkuang li makha bang a bawl a-om ding ahi, apakmumte leh pakte uh toh.
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

paite: Huai mah ahiang nihte nuai ah pakmum khat a-om dia, huai mah ahiang nihte nuai ah apakmum khawnvak koihna a pan a hong suakkhia hiang gukte dungzui in.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

paite: Apakmumte leh ahiangte akibang ding ua, avek in dangka-engtak a sekthoh ahi ding hi.
english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

paite: Huai ah khawnvak sagih na bawl dia; khawnvakte ade ding ua, apang a vakna apiaktheihna ding un.
english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

paite: Ataitehte leh ameivu kuangte, dangka-engtak ahi ding ua;
english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

paite: belsuan tengteng toh dangka-engtak talent khat a bawl ding ahi.
english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

paite: Tang a ka hon etsak lim dungzui a bawl ding in pilvang in," achi hi.
english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
